final: WITH m AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, l.WBC * 1.0 / l.PLT AS wp, l.HGB * 1.0 / l.HCT AS hh FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID), g AS (SELECT sex, AVG(wp) AS avg_wp, AVG(hh) AS avg_hh FROM m GROUP BY sex), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wp) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.sex, g.avg_wp, g.avg_hh, g.avg_wp - o.overall AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.sex
